subject: Re: Tracerless shim pilot — Convergent Labs connector proposal
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@convergentlabs.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@convergentlabs.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tracerless shim pilot proposal — Convergent x Redwood

Hi Mateo,

Great to meet you on the call last week. Convergent Labs builds lightweight instrumentation layers for ISVs that want observability without deep SDK changes. We put together a short proposal for a "tracerless shim" that can detect LangChain / LlamaIndex calls in-app and emit telemetry to Redwood's observability endpoint with minimal customer code changes.

High-level ask:
- Pilot a tracerless shim integration with Redwood's hosted runtime for one ISV customer (we can use a sandbox).
- Validate span mapping for prompt generation, embedding calls, and KV/cache interactions.
- Acceptance: token-level attribution in Redwood Console and a sample set of 50 prompts passing our QA.

Initial timeline: 3 weeks (scoped POC) with optional extension to certification for marketplace.

Attached: convergent-tracerless-shim-deck.pdf (5 slides)

Questions for you:
1) Does Redwood have a recommended telemetry ingestion endpoint for partner-generated spans?
2) Any security/compliance constraints we should know about for a sandbox trial?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short sync.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships | Convergent Labs
elena.soto@convergentlabs.com

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@convergentlabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tracerless shim pilot — Convergent x Redwood

Thanks Elena — this looks interesting. Quick answers up front:
- We do have a partner ingestion path for telemetry; we prefer signed tokens and a scoped ingestion key (sandbox-only) rather than wide-open endpoints.
- For sandboxes, we generally allow reduced retention and require a short data handling attestation.

Cc'ing Vanessa (partnerships) to loop in coverage for operational/marketplace checks and Kimberly (security) in a follow-up.

Two asks from our side to scope the POC:
1) Can you enumerate the exact SDKs and call sites you detect for LangChain / LlamaIndex (e.g., chain.run, index.query, embedder.encode)? That helps us draft validation tests.
2) Provide a minimal test harness or a public sample app we can run in our staging infra so SRE can validate streaming and attribution.

Can you do an initial sync Mon/Tue next week? I can share a rough SOW draft beforehand. Attaching a very rough SOW (redwood-sow-draft-v0.2.docx) for internal review.

—Mateo
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Risk & ops items to triage:

- Legal/Marketplace: if this becomes a certified connector, we need a lightweight integration agreement. Vanessa to own with partnerships.

Vanessa

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@convergentlabs.com>

Cc: Tom Wei <tom.wei@orbitsys.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tracerless shim pilot — Convergent x Redwood

Thanks, Mateo & Vanessa — great to be looped in. Quick responses inline: 

- SDKs / call sites: we detect common LangChain entry points (LLMChain.run, AgentExecutor.invoke), LlamaIndex query/index APIs (SimpleDirectoryReader.load -> Index.query), and typical embedding wrappers (embedder.encode). Full list attached as a CSV in the deck notes.
- Test harness: we have a tiny sample app (public repo) that simulates a prompt flow + embedding calls. Repo: https://github.com/convergentlabs/tracerless-samples (README includes env var toggles).
- Security: we can operate entirely in a customer sandbox (no PII) and issue events to a scoped ingestion token. We are happy to sign a short attestation.

We can provision sandbox credentials today if you confirm the preferred ingestion pattern (signed scoped token + endpoint). Proposed kickoff: Tue 22 Sep, 10:00 PT.

Attaching: convergent-tracerless-shim-deck.pdf (deck notes include CSV).

—Elena
